preoblongata.definition: n. The anterior part of the medulla oblongata.
preoblongata.translation: [医] 延髓前部(第四脑室与脑桥间的部分)

preoccupancy.definition: n. the act of taking occupancy before someone else does
preoccupancy.translation:
n. 先占, 先占权, 先取, 全神贯注
[法] 先占, 先取, 先占权

preoccupant.translation: a. 抢先占据的, 抢先占有的

preoccupation.definition:
n. an idea that preoccupies the mind and holds the attention
n. the mental state of being preoccupied by something
preoccupation.translation:
n. 抢先占据, 先人之见, 入神
[医] 成见, 注意散漫, 心不在焉

preoccupations.definition:
n. an idea that preoccupies the mind and holds the attention
n. the mental state of being preoccupied by something
n. the act of taking occupancy before someone else does
preoccupations.translation: n. 全神贯注( preoccupation的复数形式 ); 入神; 当务之急; 使人全神贯注的事物

preoccupied.definition:
v engage or engross the interest or attention of beforehand or occupy urgently or obsessively
v occupy or take possession of beforehand or before another or appropriate for use in advance
s deeply absorbed in thought
s having or showing excessive or compulsive concern with something
preoccupied.translation: a. 被先占的, 入神的, 一心一意的

preoccupies.definition:
v engage or engross the interest or attention of beforehand or occupy urgently or obsessively
v occupy or take possession of beforehand or before another or appropriate for use in advance
preoccupies.translation: v. 占据（某人）思想, 使对…全神贯注, 使专心于( preoccupy的第三人称单数 )

preoccupy.definition:
v. engage or engross the interest or attention of beforehand or occupy urgently or obsessively
v. occupy or take possession of beforehand or before another or appropriate for use in advance
preoccupy.translation: vt. 抢先占领, 使全神贯注

preoccupying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Preoccupy
preoccupying.translation: v. 占据（某人）思想, 使对…全神贯注, 使专心于( preoccupy的现在分词 )

preocular.definition:
a. Placed just in front of the eyes, as the antennae of
   certain insects.
n. One of the scales just in front of the eye of a reptile
   or fish.

preoiler.translation: 预先加油器, 预润滑器

preoperation.translation: 空转, 试运行, 试运转

preoperative.definition: s. happening or done before and in preparation for a surgical operation
preoperative.translation:
a. 手术前的
[医] 手术前的

preoperculum.definition: n. The anterior opercular bone in fishes.

preoral.definition:
a. Situated in front of, or anterior to, the mouth; as,
   preoral bands.

preoral gut.translation: [医] 口前肠, 西赛耳氏憩室(咽底憩室)

preorbital.definition: a. Situated in front or the orbit.
preorbital.translation:
n. 眶前骨
a. 位于眼眶前方的

preordain.translation: vt. 注定, 预先决定

preordained.translation: v. 预先规定, 注定( preordain的过去式和过去分词 ); 天定

preordaining.translation: v. 预先规定, 注定( preordain的现在分词 )

preordains.translation: v. 预先规定, 注定( preordain的第三人称单数 )

preorder.definition: v. t. To order to arrange beforehand; to foreordain.

preordination.definition: n (theology) being determined in advance; especially the doctrine (usually associated with Calvin) that God has foreordained every event throughout eternity (including the final salvation of mankind)
preordination.translation: n. 注定, 预先决定

preowned.translation: adj. 第二手的，旧的，二手的
